G.name: Jones, Mike
G.team: G4/ We're Sexy & We Throw It

predictions: We're still missing one result from week 13, but so far I'm a very stout 20-4 for the week. If I got the missing result correct, a 21-4 mark would be my best week of the season so far. Anyway, up to that match, I'm now 233-90 for the season (72.1% correct), and I have a winning record with 49 of the 53 teams (5-5 with Off Constantly-Reboot; 6-7 with both Trips Are For Kids and Bangin the Wire; and 4-7 with Shooter McGavin).

Match of the week: (G Div.) That's What She Said @ Dart Vader's. In the middle of the season, Vader's lost three matches in one month, and then lost more than half their roster. Now they're basically playing with only five, and… they have fought all the way into a head-to-head title matchup!! Does She Said end their crazy story? I think so, 14-10.

Matches #2 & #3: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Hump Day!; Shooter McGavin @ Rif Raf. The C race all season has felt a bit like a continual game of "I don't want it, you take it." Off Constantly was 5-1 before losing 4 of 5. McGavin was 7-1 before losing 2 of 3. Hump Day, on the other hand dropped a couple early and sprinkled throughout, and only just took the lead by beating a 4-win team in 1001. We're down to two, and it's not really clear which has the harder matchup to finish. Regardless, I think both escape. Hump, 14-10; McGavin, 13-11.

Match #4: (A Div.) The Bullies @ Element XL. This one doesn't have the luster that it sometimes does, but the fact remains that this is very clearly the league's top two superpowers. I actually expect there could be a few of the major players in the matchup missing this particular night, but there will still be (calm) fireworks. Have to take my team, 13-11.

Match #5: (G Div.) The Neighborhood Dart Knights @ Bottoms Up. Somebody is going to win the Match of the Week above, so Bottoms can't take home the G crown. But if they can win here, they will pass the wildly inconsistent Corkers, 14-10; but if Dart Side falls, Death Throw is going to race on by into 2nd on the power of a 13-9 win.
Match #8: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Inconsistently Consistent. No team is winning its division by more than Attack is. But uber-hot Consistent is going to make an undefeated run tough. Attack, 14-10.

Match #9: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Why So Serious? This match is honestly kind of huge. If all the same teams sign up again next season, the winner of this one gets to stay in A. And being an A team is a big damn deal. Super hard to stay there. Serious, 13-11.
Match #10: (E Div.) Irish Ton @ Duck Around & Find Out. This is likely a head-to-head to determine a bottom-two E spot, regardless of the missing week 13 outcome. Ducks get this one in a tiebreaker.
Match #11: (F Div.) Zero Dart Ton 80 @ Rippin Darts. Likely a preview of the F tournament final? Or is this the biggest threat to Zero Dart's perfect season. Well, it's both. And Zero wins, 15-9.
Match #12: (D Div.) Reload @ Sharky's Machine. All Reload has to do to clinch 2nd in D is win this match. And last time they just thumped Machine. They win again, but it won't be so easy. 15-9.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Lunatic Fringe 15, 2 Liver Die with LA 9.
B Division: Raging Bulls Eyes 14, Matt's Tab 10; Double In, Stumble Out 13, Trips Are For Kids 11; Bandits 13, Nine Lives 11.
C Division: The Outlaws 14, Darty Sanchez 10.
D Division: DD-214 14, Ton 80 Proof 10; Rangers 16, She-Unit 8.
E Division: Liquor Possee 16, Bangin The Wire 8.
F Division: Sofa Kings 15, Coach's Last Dance 9; Shark Shooters 16, The Dartifacts 8; Nein Mark 14, Triple Shots 10.
G Division: Killer Dee's 16, Crafts 8; We Throw It 14, Salute 10.
